Architecture / Evaluation → optimization → world

One trajectory.
Three jobs.

  1. 01

    MarioEval reads the whole interaction.

    Scene, latent state, and event-chain signals are evaluated through L1–L6 cascaded rubrics and user-interest-aware halting. The result separates style, persona, drift, and agency rather than collapsing the trajectory into one score.

  2. 02

    MarioOpt converts failure into learning signal.

    Hierarchical Reward Decomposition constructs curriculum-shaped rewards; Experience-Focused Policy Optimization returns to the moment where a trajectory starts to fail and repairs it using faithful user simulators.

  3. 03

    The world preserves consequences.

    Actions update latent states, future events, trust, and available choices. Evaluation, simulation, and optimization become one persistent environment rather than three disconnected pipelines.
